architectural-decision-records.why: records the travel decision and the allow-empty-vs-routing scan-model choice
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0062: migration-safety + alert-hygiene travel via --allow-empty + --ignore scripts/ci; why whole-repo allow-empty was chosen over per-push routing; alert-hygiene also allow-empties the zero-alert-block case; dual-path test fix for all five travelling gates
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

pattern-selector.why: chose the scan-scope mechanism deliberately against the forces, naming the rejected option
pattern-selector.what: selected the proven --allow-empty whole-repo scan over adding per-push routing to the aggregator, because routing would be a second parallel way to decide whether a gate runs (a duplicate mechanism); recorded the choice and its guarantee in the ADR
quotes: A pattern removes one specific kind of failure or rot

release-deployment-safety.why: made this skill structural gate (migration-safety) travel into and enforce in consumers
release-deployment-safety.what: added --allow-empty + --ignore + IGNORE_DIRS to check-migration-safety.mjs so a whole-consumer scan skips gate infra and test fixtures and passes a repo with no migrations, while still flagging an unsafe migration in product code
quotes: Every change must be independently deployable, backward-compatible, observable while it rolls out

sre-operational-readiness.why: made this skill structural gate (alert-hygiene) travel into and enforce in consumers
sre-operational-readiness.what: added --allow-empty (covering BOTH no-yaml and no-alert-block, the common consumer case) + --ignore + IGNORE_DIRS to check-alert-hygiene.mjs, while still flagging a cause-based page with missing annotations in product code
quotes: measure user-facing health, alert on it, respond, learn, adjust

verifiable-quality-gates.why: every new behavior and the meta-test has a discriminating test proven to detect
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added --allow-empty/--ignore/anti-fixture discrimination tests for both gates; extended the CONSUMER-TESTS meta-test to run all five travelling-gate tests in a bootstrapped consumer so a gate whose copied test cannot resolve or detect fails
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: tested at unit level and end-to-end through genesis into a consumer
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests exercise the flag and scope logic for both gates; the genesis integration path bootstraps a consumer, runs the aggregator over all eight gates clean, then confirms a bad migration + bad alert turn it red
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the gate-script change; the travel behaviors are pinned as executable scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the behaviors (no-migration repo green, unsafe migration red, no-alert-block repo green, bad alert red, test fixtures skipped) are written as discriminating tests executed at the lowest layer that proves them
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

arch-encode.why: a caught latent gap was turned into an enforced meta-test rule
arch-encode.what: the no-ua/owasp copied tests hardcoded the upstream path (latent since ADR-0061, uncaught); encoded the rule by making all travelling-gate tests dual-path and adding them to the CONSUMER-TESTS meta-test, which now fails if any travelling gate test cannot run in a consumer
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context against the four questions before done
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch on both gate changes, the manifest entries, and the test/meta-test changes; recorded the matrix in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

skeptical-audit.why: each claim carries an evidence state and re-runnable source, disconfirming case first
skeptical-audit.what: proved travel end-to-end in a genesised consumer (8 gates green clean; migration-safety + alert-hygiene red on a planted bad migration and cause-based page) and confirmed provenance freezes the new gates invoke
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: the owasp gate behavior is unchanged; only its test file gained dual-path resolution (no product auth/input/crypto change)

universal-browser-device-support.why: the ua-sniff gate behavior is unchanged; only its test file gained dual-path resolution (no UI/browser code change)

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system/data architecture change; the manifest stays the single owner of gate args

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration in this change (the migration gate scans consumer SQL, it does not itself migrate)

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; gate scripts and tests only
